plugins.name: meeseeks
plugins.description: An autonomous build loop with an external auditor and a monotonic test ratchet. Pre-production only; never point it at anything with users.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Deterministic frontend design-slop detector. The design gate a meeseeks run arms on any target that renders a user interface; carried here so the two arrive together rather than the gate discovering its tool is missing mid-run.
